name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
label: Quest
description: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The carapace of a mature chromatic drake is needed to form the foundation of the leggings. Brilliant chromatic scales are then layered upon the wire frame and enchanted in the blood of heroes. Finally, the supple skin of shadow must be applied to the inner greaves.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Such an item has never been crafted!

clips.title: Completion
paras: They will smell their kin as you enter their halls, friend. Crush them with their own fear!
